akshay: heads up  ran into a client header compatibility issue when attempting to unpin runtime-v2.9 -> v3.0 for the embed-heavy cohort.
caroline: describe the problem?
akshay: older SDKs (<=2.7) don't include the `X-Client-Fallback` header that the new router uses to prefer pinned runtimes for certain clients. without it, a small subset of traffic is getting routed to 3.0 unexpectedly.
matt: do we have telemetry showing customer impact?
akshay: yes - about 0.2% of requests from legacy SDKs in ap-south are getting misrouted; most are harmless but a handful hit a model variant that triggers small hallucination uptick in the eval set.
rene: can we add a temporary header rewrite at the edge to inject `X-Client-Fallback: runtime-v2.9` for matching user-agents?
ivy: that would be fastest. ops note: edge-rewrite requires a 15m deploy and a config rollout to all edge nodes. low risk.
deploybot: validation job queued (id: hdr-1102). running: routing-sanity, header-rewrite-smoke, SDK-compat-check.
deploybot: validation results: routing-sanity OK, header-rewrite-smoke FAIL on 1/3 nodes (node: edge-az3) - config hung during reload, see /ci/artifacts/hdr-1102/logs.
caroline: if edge rewrite is flaky we should avoid large-scale unpin. what's the mitigation?
akshay: alternative is to require SDK >=2.8 for the unpin, and keep a soft-pin for older SDKs by model tag. but that means some customers won't get the cost improvements.
matt: can we do a partial rollout: unpin for SDK>=2.8 across regions, keep SDK<2.8 traffic pinned until edge fix?
akshay: yes, router supports conditional pinning by header. we'll need to ensure header detection uses `User-Agent` or `X-Sdk-Version`. current proxy emits `X-SDK-Version` when present. older SDKs don't emit it.
rene: ops requests timeline to test edge-rewrite again in the maintenance window 03:30-04:00 UTC.
ivy: QA: I'll run regression on the hallucination set once we have SDK-gated rollout up.
deploybot: note: we can create a canary rule: `if X-SDK-Version >= '2.8' -> route to runtime-v3.0 else -> runtime-v2.9` and apply to 100% in region. will produce dry-run logs.
akshay: push draft release-note blurb: "Unpin runtime-v3.0 for SDK >=2.8; older SDKs will remain on runtime-v2.9 until edge header rewrite is stable. This ensures consistent routing and preserves safety for legacy clients."
caroline: add action items: 1) ops retry edge-rewrite rollout in 03:30 window (rene). 2) akshay to prepare router rule and dry-run. 3) ivy to prepare QA plan and smoke prompts. 4) schedule final decision by 04:15 UTC.
matt: also add to status page: "SDK-gated unpin in progress; potential partial exposure for legacy clients"
deploybot: scheduled: sdk-gate-unpin job hdr-1102 scheduled for 8765441400 (03:30 UTC). will post status updates and will attempt auto-rollback on `fallback_mismatch_rate > 0.2%` or `regression_score_delta > 0.01`.
akshay: tiny dev note: I'll add the header emit in SDK 2.8 with a fallback so new clients are explicit. patch ready in branch `sdk/header-2.8`.
caroline: ok team, if edge-rewrite passes we lift the soft-pin for SDK>=2.8 tonight and leave a hard pin for older SDKs until next week. everyone ack?
rene: ack, will retry and report.
ivy: ack, QA on-call for the window.
matt: ack.
deploybot: update: hdr-1102 preflight succeeded on 2/3 nodes after manual reload. ops note: recommend rerun to confirm flakiness resolved before global rollout.
caroline: thanks  we'll reconvene at 03:15 UTC.
